sections.title: batch(), assign_tasks()
sections.body:
Batch data into groups of n Assign tasks to workers in round-robin

```python
def batch(iterable, n):
    """Batch data into groups of n"""
    it = iter(iterable)
    while True:
        batch_items = list(islice(it, n))
        if not batch_items:
            return
        yield batch_items

data = list(range(1, 16))
print(f"Data: {data}")
print("Batches of 4:")
for i, batch_items in enumerate(batch(data, 4), 1):
    print(f"  Batch {i}: {batch_items}")

def assign_tasks(tasks, workers):
    """Assign tasks to workers in round-robin"""
    worker_cycle = cycle(workers)
    assignments = {}

    for task in tasks:
        worker = next(worker_cycle)
        if worker not in assignments:
            assignments[worker] = []
        assignments[worker].append(task)

    return assignments

workers = ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"]
```

```python
def running_average(numbers):
    """Calculate running average"""
    cumsum = list(accumulate(numbers))
    return [s / (i + 1) for i, s in enumerate(cumsum)]

data = [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]
averages = running_average(data)

print(f"Data: {data}")
print("Running averages:")
for i, (val, avg) in enumerate(zip(data, averages), 1):
    print(f"  After {i} values: {avg:.2f}")
```

```python
@lru_cache(maxsize=None)
def fib_cached(n):
    if n < 2:
        return n
    return fib_cached(n - 1) + fib_cached(n - 2)
```

sections.title: sliding_window()
sections.body:
Generate sliding windows of size n

```python
def sliding_window(iterable, n):
    """Generate sliding windows of size n"""
    it = iter(iterable)
    window = list(islice(it, n))
    if len(window) == n:
        yield tuple(window)
    for item in it:
        window = window[1:] + [item]
        yield tuple(window)

data = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
print(f"Data: {data}")
print("Sliding windows (size 3):")
for window in sliding_window(data, 3):
    print(f"  {window} -> sum = {sum(window)}")
```

sections.body:
Generate consecutive pairs

```python
def pairwise(iterable):
    """Generate consecutive pairs"""
    a, b = tee(iterable)
    next(b, None)
    return zip(a, b)

numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
print(f"Numbers: {numbers}")
print("Consecutive pairs and their sums:")
for a, b in pairwise(numbers):
    print(f"  ({a}, {b}) -> sum = {a + b}")

# ============================================================================

Use reduce to find the product of all numbers and GCD.
"""
)

numbers = [12, 18, 24, 30]

# Product of all numbers
product = reduce(operator.mul, numbers)
print(f"Numbers: {numbers}")
print(f"Product: {product}")

# GCD of all numbers
import math

gcd_all = reduce(math.gcd, numbers)
print(f"GCD: {gcd_all}")

# Create nested dict from keys
keys = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
result = reduce(lambda acc, key: {key: acc}, reversed(keys), "value")
print(f"\nNested dict from {keys}: {result}")
```
